title: Cosmic Crystal Ball
description: A glowing crystal ball sits on a metallic base, containing a surreal miniature scene. Inside, a luminous blue woman in a flowing gown reaches upward toward a central red orb emitting electric blue energy tendrils that connect to floating purple planets, stars, and a red ringed planet, while purple energy roots spread across a green grassy base with small glowing trees.
